name: banxu_daily_spin

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 17 * * *'  # 00:00 VN (UTC+7) = 17:00 UTC ngày trước
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runtime:
        description: 'Test mode (skip transfer)'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: banxu-daily-spin
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  spin:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install websocket-client -q --break-system-packages

      - name: Run ban_xu daily spin
        env:
          FB_COOKIES: ${{ secrets.FB_COOKIES }}
        run: |
          echo "=== $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') Starting ban_xu daily spin ==="
          python3 spin_banxu_daily.py
          echo "=== Done ==="
